issuer: the Traffic Branch of the Mauritius Police Force (its Licensing Office)
note: The Mauritius Police Force's page 'Application for Driving Licence' (read 2026-10-30): the Traffic Branch issues and controls driving licences in Mauritius and Rodrigues; one first applies for a provisional driving licence (minimum age for a motor car 18); an application for a driving licence is made on Police Form PF 31 with a non-refundable application fee of Rs 500, the fee held (the page's fee list gives "Application for driving licence – Rs 500"); the driving test (Rs 500) isn't held. The age: the Road Traffic Act (Act 22 of 1962, Revised Laws of Mauritius, issue 7, amended to 2015 as its notes show), as the National Land Transport Authority publishes it, s 43(3): a person under 18 shall not drive a motor vehicle other than an autocycle, a motorcycle or an invalid carriage on a road, and s 43(7): a person so barred by age is deemed disqualified from holding or obtaining any licence to drive it; s 44: a driving licence is granted on passing the test of competence, with no probationary period before it. So the full licence for a motor car is held from 18 on the Act's age bar, not on the provisional licence's age alone (the age the held file lacked a source for). Later amending Acts (2018 to 2025, listed on the Authority's page) weren't read. Neither source gives a term for the licence (null). No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.

sources.title: Mauritius Police Force, Application for Driving Licence
sources.said: The Traffic Branch of the Mauritius Police Force is responsible for the issue and control of Driving Licences in Mauritius and Rodrigues. ... Application for driving licence shall be made in a Police Form (PF 31) and shall be accompanied by a Non- Refundable application fee of Rs 500. ... Minimum age requirement for a provisional driving licence ... Motorcar : 18 yrs ... Application for driving licence – Rs 500 Driving Test Fee – Rs 500
